senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be warm, hot; [(of color) to be dark, red; (of taste) to be pungent, sour, bitter]. Part. חָם, q. v.
to heat, warm, boil. Y. Ned. IV, 38ᶜ bot. לחַמֵּם בו את ידיו to warm his hands against it (the bread).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14">Gen. R. s. 14</cite>, end <he>מְחַמֶּמֶת הגוף</he> keeps the body warm.
<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:4">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>ומְחַמַּמְתָּהּ וכ׳</he> and warms it (her hand) before the fire; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:5">Bets. II, 5</cite> <he>לא יֵחֵם וכ׳</he> one must not prepare warm water for &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 40a:8-9">Sabb. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>התחילו … להָחֵם בשבת</he> the bathers began to heat (the water) on the Sabbath; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="M01119"><he>מֵיחֵם</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00897"><he>מֵחֵם</he></cite>, pl. <he>מְחַמִּין</he>. Ib.ᵇ; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 7 <he>מיחם אדם וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>מייחם</he>, read: <he>מֵיחֵים</he>), v. <cite ref="A01818"><he>אְלוּנְטִית</he> I</cite>; [Y. ib. XIX, 17ᵃ bot. <he>מחמין הוא אדם</he> (read as ib. IX, 12ᵃ bot. <he>מְחַמֵּם הוא וכ׳</he>].—Ib. <he>אם מפני הסכנה מְחַמִּין לו וכ׳</he> if it is for the sake of averting danger to life, may we not even boil water on the Sabbath?—

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:5">Sabb. III, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 41a:9">41ᵃ</cite>) <he>בשביל שיֵחַמּוּ</he> that they become warm; <cite ref="Shabbat 41b:2">Sabb. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>שיֵחוֹמּוּ</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:5">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:5">IV</cite>), 5 <he>שׁיֵיחַמּוּ</he>; a. e.
<cite ref="Shabbat 134b:15">Sabb. 134ᵇ</cite> <he>שהוּחַמּוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="H01135"><he>חָם</he> II</cite>. Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:3">B. Mets. VI, 3</cite> <he>הוּחַמָּה</he> the animal was overtaken by the heat.

senses.gloss: to warm one’s self; to become heated.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:5">Bets. II, 5</cite>; Tosef. Sabb. l. c.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:10">Ab. II, 10</cite> <he>הוי מִתְחַמֵּם וכ׳</he> warm thyself by the fire of the scholars (try to associate with them); a. fr.—Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ bot. <cite ref="H00613"><he>נתח׳</he></cite> was heated (had pollution).
